When I use it on active pimples, it helps calm the redness and brings the size down within a day or two. It doesn't make the pimple vanish overnight, but it definitely helps it heal faster. I also like that from some angles it's almost invisible once applied, but you would notice it up close… so I can wear it during the day for remote work as well.. without anyone noticing. Just make sure your skin is clean and dry before applying it that makes it stick and work better. Overall, it's been one of the few treatments that actually works for me without irritating my skin.
